what: On a trial's Changes tab, the Next trial button looks ready as soon as the page appears, but a click on it before the watchlist's list of trials to review has loaded does nothing, and nothing says so; the person has to notice and click again. When this trial is the last one to review, the same button is first enabled and then turns itself off. This issue's fix makes the moment easier to hit: the review bar now looks complete while that list is still loading, where before its first line was blank. I ran it: with that list held back, I clicked Next trial, let the list load, and the page stayed on the same trial (red at both window sizes). The cause is that the page attaches the button's action, or disables it, only after that list has answered, and leaves the button enabled and inert until then.
